body.purpose: Every heading, button, label, and paragraph in the interface chrome.

title-compact.purpose: Panel-level headings inside a focused single-card surface (e.g. auth flow headings) — quieter than Page Title.

label.purpose: Status badges and nav microcopy — always plain-language, never raw identifiers.

mono.purpose: Diffs, IDs, inline code — the only place monospace appears.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: The one non-glow shadow; separates sticky header/panels from the void background.

shadows.name: glow-info
shadows.purpose: Focus rings, hover-lift, the 'connected' status dot.

motion.name: materialize
motion.purpose: One-shot entrance for panels/route content: fade + slight scale/translate + brightness flash.

motion.name: flicker-in
motion.purpose: Signal-flicker entrance, used sparingly for a 'coming online' moment.

motion.name: pulse-glow
motion.purpose: Looping glow breathing for live/active indicators (never a one-shot).

motion.name: scan-sweep-loop
motion.purpose: Looping progress-bar sweep for indeterminate loading (boot screen).

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Terminal-style caret blink, used sparingly as a single accent, not throughout the UI.

motion.name: stagger-in
motion.purpose: Staggered list/line reveal with translateY, delayed per item.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #51f0a8; color: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(81,240,168,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(81,240,168,0.5), 0 0 12px 0 rgba(81,240,168,0.35); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action, sits on the void background.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #000000; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #26262a; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #1a1b1b; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(81,240,168,0.5), 0 0 12px 0 rgba(81,240,168,0.35); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field: transparent fill, hairline border, mint focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #26262a; background: transparent; color: #f4f4f5; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8a8d; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #51f0a8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(81,240,168,0.35), 0 0 12px 0 rgba(81,240,168,0.3); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The base surface for grouped content — translucent graphite over the void, blurred, hairline border, no shadow at rest.
components.html:
Project overview
Panel content goes here.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(10,10,10,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(38,38,42,0.8); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: #f4f4f5; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-panel-body { color: #a8a8ac; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Glyph + plain-language label in the matching semantic color; the canonical way any revision/document state is shown.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-review { color: #ffb188; } .ds-status-approved { color: #9effa1; } .ds-status-rejected { color: #ff78a5; } .ds-status-draft { color: #8a8a8d; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active state is a left-edge mint border + soft mint wash, never a filled pill; inactive nudges right on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: #8a8a8d; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #f4f4f5; background: rgba(26,27,27,0.3); transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-item-active { border-left-color: #51f0a8; background: rgba(81,240,168,0.1); color: #f4f4f5; }

narrative.overview: Kenoma reads as a quiet, confident operations HUD — the visual language of a system monitoring something that matters, not a marketing surface and not a literal terminal emulator. The canonical theme is near-black (#000000) with soft graphite panels, thin hairline borders, and a restrained mint/peach/lime/magenta signal palette that only glows when something is genuinely happening: a focused field, a live status, a successful save. At rest, the interface is calm and precise; state changes are where the personality lives, expressed through color glow and motion rather than decoration. This is a deliberate refinement of an earlier, more literal terminal aesthetic. The system explicitly rejects CLI cosplay: no $/>/# prompt glyphs prefixing copy, no ALL-CAPS jargon in toasts or status text, no raw snake_case/enum strings surfaced to users. Monospace (JetBrains Mono) is reserved for genuinely data-shaped content — diffs, IDs, code-like fragments — and never used as the default UI voice; Space Grotesk carries every heading, button, and body string.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canonical theme with a light counterpart that inverts contrast while preserving the same signal hues and density.
One primary accent (mint) used sparingly; peach/lime/magenta exist purely as semantic status colors, never as decoration.
Depth conveyed through glow and blur, not drop-shadow elevation.
Precise, responsive micro-motion signals state changes rather than being ambient decoration.
Monospace is a data marker, not a brand voice.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Only one accent (mint) is used for anything non-semantic. Peach/lime/magenta never appear except as warning/success/error.

rules.name: The Light Theme Inverts, Never Drifts Rule
rules.body: Light mode remaps the same neutral and signal roles onto a paper-on-graphite scheme holding the same contrast targets — it is not a separate palette.

rules.name: The No Raw Identifiers Rule
rules.body: Enum values and permission keys never render verbatim in UI copy — every one is mapped to a human label before display.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth reads through color intensity and blur radius, never through a heavier drop shadow.

dos: Do reserve JetBrains Mono for diffs, IDs, and code-like fragments only.
Do map every enum/status value to a plain-language label before it reaches UI copy.
Do express depth and emphasis through signal-color glow + blur, never through added drop-shadow weight.
Do keep the signal-mint accent rare — reserve it for the one primary action or focus state per view.
Do drive animation from real state changes and loop any 'waiting' animation rather than timing it to a guess.
donts: Don't prefix headings, buttons, or toasts with $, >, #, or any literal shell-prompt glyph.
Don't write ALL-CAPS or jargon-heavy status/toast copy — use plain sentence-case, human phrasing.
Don't surface raw snake_case/enum strings directly in UI text.
Don't introduce a fifth 'decorative' accent color — peach/lime/magenta are semantic-only.
Don't reach for a heavier box-shadow to convey elevation; use glow.
